items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Then Phil Moore worked with her for awhile, but he had other commitments.

ctx.x: So I think Phil Moore -- well, Eddie Beal somehow didn't work out well with her. He's a marvelous accompanist, but he didn't work well with Lena, seemingly. Then Phil Moore worked with her for awhile, but he had other commitments. But he did work with her and help her, to coach her. And then she finally got a guy named Arthur Twine, who was a very fine little pianist, and he had a lot of experience accompanying people, you know.
